title: The Contest of Dragon Veins
next_chapter_hook: The eerie fissure on the barrier of the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds emanated a blood resonance only he could sense—Chen Nian was right there.

text.content: As Su Qingyao opened the gilded secret letter from the imperial capital, her fingers trembled slightly—three days until the Crown Prince's birthday banquet. Yet what truly chilled her was the final line: 'Deep within the imperial capital's forbidden grounds, an ancient dragon vein stirs, shaking the world.' She raised her gaze, instinctively drifting toward the figure sweeping the floor in the corner. Chen Ji's movements remained unhurried, as if the world's tumultuous changes held no concern for him.

Almost simultaneously, three hundred li from the imperial capital at the Tianqing Sect's Back Mountain Forbidden Grounds, an invisible pressure spread from the earth's depths. The swords in the hands of mountain-guarding disciples hummed shrilly, and some with lower cultivation vomited blood from the sheer pressure. Ling Yuan stood before the closed meditation stone chamber, his withered hand slowly clenching—the awakening of the dragon vein had come three years earlier than he had anticipated.

dialogue.content: "It's here." The aged voice of Mo Xiansheng emerged from the first page of the Tianji Record, carrying a subtle weight. "The Contest of Dragon Veins is fundamentally a redistribution of the world's fortune. If you wish to save her, this is the best opportunity—and also the most dangerous."

text.content: Chen Ji's sweeping finally ceased. He lifted his gaze toward the direction of the imperial capital, a sharp gleam flickering in his eyes. Three years of layout, fifty points of Heavenly Fate invested in hidden pieces—now was the time to reap the harvest. The Holy Sect's barrier fluctuates every thirty years—and the spiritual energy chaos caused by the dragon vein contest is precisely the optimal timing to break through this barrier.

choice.prompt: The Contest of Dragon Veins has begun, and all forces stir restlessly. Chen Ji must make a choice amid the chaos—whether to seize the dragon vein for greater leverage, or infiltrate the Holy Sect to rescue his sister while the world burns.

choices.description: The fortune power within the dragon vein can accelerate the Tianji Record's restoration—true strength is fundamental. The rescue can wait, but the dragon vein must never fall into others' hands.
choices.visible_cost: Miss the optimal rescue timing, and Chen Nian may be relocated again
choices.visible_reward: Gain the dragon vein's fortune blessing, allowing the Tianji Record to unseal more functions
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan is also competing for the dragon vein—direct confrontation carries extreme risk

text.content: Chen Ji leaned the broom against the wall, a subtle curve forming at the corner of his lips. Atrash杂役? Perfect—no one would notice an ant's movements. He turned toward the back mountain, footsteps soundless, like a wisp of blue smoke dissolving into the night.

choices.description: Chen Nian has been imprisoned far too long—the barrier fissure caused by the dragon vein contest is a rare once-in-a-millennium opportunity. Miss it again, and who knows how many more years of waiting.
choices.visible_cost: Abandon the dragon vein contest, and the world's fortune will be completely reshuffled
choices.visible_reward: If successfully rescuing Chen Nian, obtain key information about the 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key'
choices.risk_hint: The Holy Sect's forbidden grounds are heavily guarded—rushing in means nine deaths, one survival

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes darkened. For three years he had countless times seen his sister's blurry figure in dreams—she was his only blood relative in this world. The dragon vein can wait, but Chen Nian... he could not make her wait another moment.

choices.memory_label: 营救妹妹是陈机最大的执念

choices.description: Use hidden operatives to manipulate both lines simultaneously—personally infiltrate the Holy Sect while arranging for Ye Qing to compete for the dragon vein on his behalf.
choices.visible_cost: Requires consuming more Heavenly Fate Value to maintain information synchronization on both fronts
choices.visible_reward: Both opportunities to rescue Chen Nian and to secure the dragon vein's fortune
choices.risk_hint: Once either line reveals a flaw, the entire situation may collapse

dialogue.content: "You certainly trust me." Ye Qing's voice drifted from the shadows, carrying a playful tone. "The Contest of Dragon Veins determines the world's fortune distribution—you'd really let me handle something this major?"

text.content: In the Crown Prince's palace in the imperial capital, lanterns blazed with brilliant light. Crown Prince Xiao Yan burned the secret letter, his eyes gleaming sharply: "The Dragon Vein awakens—this is a heaven-sent opportunity. Issue the order: on the day of the birthday banquet, the core figures of Xuanwu Sect, Qingyun Pavilion, and Tianqing Sect must all be present—I shall see for myself who is the true master of the Dragon Vein." His voice was cold and arrogant, unaware that multiple pairs of eyes in the shadows had already fixed upon this grand banquet.

In the Grand Council Hall of Tianqing Sect, Ling Yuan sat regally at the main seat. Below stood Han Lie and other core disciples. His withered fingers tapped rhythmically against the armrest as his voice seemed to emerge from the Nine Abysses: "The Dragon Vein contention concerns our Tianqing Sect's century-long fortune. Does that waste Chen Ji also come to make trouble?" He sneered coldly, "Let him go. Wastes have their uses—dying outside saves me the trouble of handling it personally."

Yet at this moment, Chen Ji had silently departed from Tianqing Sect. He traversed along the mountain path between towering peaks, each step landing precisely on the nodes where worldly energy flowed. The Tianji Record Fragment within his Mental Sea radiated gentle warmth, continuous blurry images emerging—the direction of the imperial capital, Dragon Vein energy churning like a colossal serpent; further away at the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds, a subtle fissure slowly expanding as the Dragon Vein trembled.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji." Ling Yuan's aged voice suddenly resounded behind Chen Ji, his withered figure somehow already standing ten zhang away. "The Dragon Vein contention approaches—where are you going?" His gaze was as coldly sinister as a venomous snake, as if he had already seen through Chen Ji.

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan suddenly appeared, blocking Chen Ji's path. Coincidence, or had he sensed something long ago?

choices.description: Adopt the waste persona, claim merely going out for fresh air, never reveal the true purpose.
choices.visible_cost: Waste precious time, Ling Yuan may probe further
choices.visible_reward: Maintain the disguise, Ling Yuan will temporarily not suspect
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan's suspicion has already arisen, a simple lie may not deceive him

dialogue.content: "Reporting to the Sect Master," Chen Ji hastily bowed, his voice carrying traces of fear, "The disciple has recently made no progress in cultivation, wishes to take a breath of fresh air below the mountain... dares not delay the Sect's great affairs!" His posture was humble to the extreme, like a withered leaf，随时会被风吹走。

choices.description: Directly question Ling Yuan's presence here, attack while defending, disrupt his rhythm.
choices.visible_cost: Expose some sharpness, may deepen Ling Yuan's vigilance
choices.visible_reward: Control dialogue initiative, force Ling Yuan to reveal flaws
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan is a calculating old fox, direct confrontation carries great risk

dialogue.content: Chen Ji straightened up, his gaze calmly meeting Ling Yuan's. Those eyes held not a trace of cowardice befitting a waste, but were deep as an abyss, as if capable of seeing through human hearts. "Senior Brother, you come to this place so late at night—for what purpose?" His voice was not loud, yet clearly penetrated the night wind.

choices.description: Consume 5 Heavenly Fate points, peer into Ling Yuan's movements within the next three hours,借此找到脱身之法。
choices.visible_reward: Gain key information, find the perfect escape timing
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate is limited, excessive consumption may affect subsequent actions

text.content: The Tianji Record Fragment within his Mental Sea slightly vibrated, an enigmatic force surging toward his eyes. Chen Ji's world suddenly became crystal clear—three quarters of an hour later, Ling Yuan would receive an urgent transmission from the imperial capital, forced to return to the Sect. Then, he would have a brief unobstructed window of action.

Just as the Tianji Record had foreseen, Ling Yuan's brow suddenly creased. A jade slip flew from his sleeve, transforming into a stream of light that vanished into his brow. After a moment, his阴sneered意凝固了："Imperial City urgent summons..." He glanced at Chen Ji, a trace of impatience flickering in his eyes, "Very well, you may go. If the Dragon Vein contention requires assistance, this seat will summon you." With that, his form dissolved like blue smoke, vanishing into the night's darkness.

Chen Ji stood in place, watching Ling Yuan depart. His expression remained calm, yet his clenched fists trembled slightly. In that instant, he clearly sensed a familiar fluctuation—it was Chen Nian's aura. The Holy Sect Forbidden Grounds' barrier fissures were more intense than he imagined. The spiritual energy chaos caused by the Dragon Vein contention was tearing apart the cage imprisoning his sister.

dialogue.content: 「Did you see that?」 Mo Xiansheng's voice echoed in the Mental Sea, carrying a hint of satisfaction. 「The Dragon Vein Contest is nothing less than a reshuffling of Heavenly Fate. Your sister is imprisoned exactly above a tributary of the Dragon Vein. The rift caused by the Dragon Vein's agitation is precisely the key to breaking the Holy Sect's seal—but also the most dangerous trigger. Once you make a move for her, the gaze of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets will certainly fall upon you.」

choice.prompt: Chen Nian's location has been locked, but the Holy Sect Forbidden Grounds' defenses and Heavenly Secrets' attention are lethal threats. At this moment, he must make the final decision.

choices.description: Seizing the opportunity when the Holy Sect experts are distracted by the Dragon Vein Contest, infiltrate the forbidden grounds alone to rescue Chen Nian. The risk is highest, but it won't implicate others.
choices.visible_cost: If failed, face the Holy Sect's wrath alone
choices.visible_reward: Successfully rescue Chen Nian, and gain the secret of the 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key'
choices.risk_hint: Unknown dangers beyond comprehension may exist deep within the forbidden grounds

text.content: Chen Ji drew a deep breath, his footsteps turning toward the Holy Sect. His silhouette under the moonlight appeared solitary and resolute. Three years of restraint, three years of scheming—all for this moment. Even if the path ahead leads through dragon's pools and tiger's dens, he would walk it himself.

choices.description: Utilize Ye Qing's 'Demonic Path Mist' to conceal the Tianji Record's aura, and infiltrate the forbidden grounds together. Her assistance would greatly increase safety.
choices.visible_cost: Owe Ye Qing a favor, and the Demonic Path Mist has a time limit
choices.visible_reward: With concealment, the risk of detection by Heavenly Secrets is greatly reduced
choices.risk_hint: Whether Ye Qing is willing to take such a huge risk remains unknown

dialogue.content: Ye Qing emerged from the shadows, Demonic Path Mist swirling around her. She gazed at Chen Ji, her lips curving into a meaningful smile: 「For your sister's sake, you're willing to spend quite a lot.」 Her voice suddenly dropped, 「But I like it—the feeling of being needed.」

choices.memory_label: 夜清与陈机建立了基于共同利益的深度信任

choices.description: The timing is still not mature enough; acting rashly may cost all your chips. Wait for a better opportunity next time.
choices.visible_cost: Chen Nian suffers another day in the forbidden grounds, and the rift may heal on its own
choices.visible_reward: Preserve the existing layout, accumulate more strength before acting
choices.risk_hint: May need to wait several decades

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, his knuckles white from tension. Reason told him this was not the best timing. But that blurred face constantly appearing in his mind was like countless fine needles, piercing his heart. Three years of separation was already long enough... Yet he ultimately turned around, walking back toward where he came from. To live is to have hope.

choices.memory_label: 陈机选择了理性的道路，但这决定让他内心备受煎熬

text.content: At the very moment Chen Ji made his choice, deep within the Holy Sect Forbidden Grounds, a faint glow flickered beneath layers of seals. Chen Nian was chained to a cold stone wall, her delicate features grown gaunt, yet her eyes remained bright as stars. She sensed something and abruptly raised her head—that was Big Brother's aura! Faint, but real. Tears fell silently as she gripped her fists tightly.

「The Dragon Vein has awakened.」 An ancient voice reverberated through the void in the depths of the Holy Sect. 「That child has also begun to act. The Wheel of Fate has started turning... In this game, does he have the higher hand, or has Heavenly Secrets long arranged the board?」 In the depths of the void, a pair of invisible eyes slowly opened, gazing indifferently at all in the world—that is the 'Eye of Heavenly Secrets' that stands above all chess players.

At the same time, above the imperial city, the sky suddenly blazed with a golden pillar of light as Dragon Vein energy surged toward the clouds. The entire world felt this immense power—the Dragon Vein Contest had officially begun. The three major sects, the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path, and even the imperial family's forces would clash in this contest. Chen Ji stood at the center of this storm; every choice he made would affect the world's pattern.

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan stood atop Tianqing Sect's highest peak, gazing toward the imperial city. A cold, sinister smile curved his lips: 「The Dragon Vein Contest—all under heaven's fate rests upon it. Does Chen Ji, thattrash, think he can remain aloof by hiding in the shadows?」 His withered palm suddenly clenched tightly, 「But he doesn't know—I have waited sixty years for this moment.」

text.content: Chen Ji withdrew his gaze, taking one final look toward the Holy Sect Forbidden Grounds. The rift in the barrier had widened large enough for one person to pass through, but the guards' strength was also rapidly increasing. He drew a deep breath, turned, and vanished into the night. The Crown Prince's birthday banquet was still three days away; the Dragon Vein Contest was merely an open chess piece on the board—the true winning move is always hidden in the dark. In three days, he would appear in the imperial city, as a 'useless servant disciple', witnessing this grand event that would change the world's pattern.

The bizarre rift on the Forbidden Grounds barrier of the Holy Sect was emanating a blood resonance only he could sense—Chen Nian was there. That night, Chen Ji made a decision: no matter what price he had to pay, he would find the path to his sister in the chaos of the Dragon Vein Contest. Even if it meant becoming an enemy of the entire world, he would not hesitate.
